headline: Grounds your residents are proud to come home to.
intro: Full-service landscape maintenance for HOAs and residential communities. Common areas, entrances, ponds, and irrigation, handled by one dependable crew on a set schedule.
service_area: Serving communities in Broward County and surrounding areas
about: Boards and property managers get one point of contact who knows your community, answers the phone, and shows up to board meetings when you need us there.

highlights.title: One account manager
highlights.text: A single contact who walks your property regularly and handles every request.

highlights.title: Reports after every visit
highlights.text: Photos and notes on what was done, so the board always knows where things stand.

highlights.title: Licensed and insured
highlights.text: Certificates of insurance ready for your management company on request.
